description: How the customer roles of an energy supplier, its balancing and portfolio operators, its large customers and its end customers relate to each other on the platform: who buys and launches propositions, how a sign-up becomes a billed connection, how validated volumes flow into forecasts, nominations, hedges and settlement, how large consumers trade and steer through their supplier, how directors and new entrants buy and steer the operation, and which information loops keep the bill correct and the customer served.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Propositions, supply contracts, click trades and platform purchases between the parties

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Onboarding, meter data, forecasts, nominations, steering and service hand-offs

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Invoices, payments, imbalance and reconciliation settlement, hedge and margin positions

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Positions, prices, reports, targets and compliance steering between the roles

relations.name: Buys a proposition through a sales channel
relations.description: Chooses a fixed, variable, dynamic, EV or feed-in proposition in the channel the proposition manager configured; the order lands with the tariff, campaign and journey settings already attached.

relations.name: Hands over launch-ready products to the billing backbone
relations.description: Publishes each proposition with its tariff structure, pricing logic and billing rules so that contracts created from it bill, settle and reconcile automatically without an engineering ticket.

relations.name: Invoices and collects
relations.description: Runs the periodic, annual and final invoices from validated volumes and contract terms, collects by direct debit, matches payments, offers payment plans and runs dunning when needed.

relations.name: Hands over validated volumes and connection changes
relations.description: Delivers validated meter data, switches, move-ins and contract changes per connection so that the BRP's forecasts, allocation and reconciliation start from the same connection register as billing.

relations.name: Gives the hedge position to balance against
relations.description: Passes the procured and hedged volumes per segment and delivery period so that the BRP nominates the open position and steers intraday against the portfolio's actual exposure.

relations.name: Reports positions, imbalance and settlement per 15 minutes
relations.description: Feeds near real-time positions, imbalance cost and reconciliation outcomes per segment back to the portfolio desk so that margin, risk and hedge coverage are read from the same numbers.

relations.name: Steers flexible assets with intraday signals
relations.description: Sends steering signals and setpoints to the industrial site's batteries, CHP and curtailable load within the agreed flexibility contract and reports what was activated and earned.

relations.name: Executes click trades and forecast updates within the framework contract
relations.description: Clicks volumes at published prices, updates site forecasts and requests contract changes through the trading desk; each trade updates the supplier's portfolio position immediately.

relations.name: Publishes price curves and cost-plus inputs
relations.description: Provides the portfolio cost, price curves and risk premiums the proposition manager prices every product and B2B quote against, so that tariffs stay profitable as the market moves.

relations.name: Raises queries, disputes and service requests
relations.description: Submits meter readings, tariff and payment changes, moving notices, questions and disputes through the white-label portal and app; whatever self-service cannot close becomes a case with full context.

relations.name: Resolves cases and keeps the customer informed
relations.description: Answers cases from the same invoice, consumption and contract data as billing, explains bill changes such as the end of net metering and dynamic pricing, and sends lifecycle and regulatory communications.

relations.name: Escalates billing disputes and corrections
relations.description: Routes disputed invoices, wrong readings and contract mismatches to billing operations for correction, and feeds the pattern of disputes back so that exception rules are fixed at the source.

relations.name: Steers cost to serve and straight-through billing
relations.description: Sets straight-through billing, correction-rate and cost-to-serve targets, reviews the operational dashboards that report against them and decides which heritage products migrate when.

relations.name: Buys managed balance responsibility or in-house BRP tooling
relations.description: Decides whether balance responsibility is run on the platform in house or outsourced as BRP as a Service on tiered MWh pricing, and holds the BRP operator to imbalance cost and compliance targets.

relations.name: Presents the market-entry case and operating model
relations.description: Brings the market-entry scan, licensing timeline, build-versus-buy decisions and KPI framework to the board or investor who approves the launch budget and the platform contract.

relations.name: Onboards balance responsibility before the first customer
relations.description: Obtains the BRP arrangement, runs shadow forecasting and market-communication tests during licensing, and hands the live portfolio to the balancing operator at go-live.
